div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe center; width: 463px; height: 1px; padding-top: 645px; margin-left: 1169px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: center; color: #000000;

div.div: Mandatory for Restaurant Admin and Super Admin.
No network connection exists between the platform and the
authenticator app. The QR code transfers the enrollment secret,
codes are generated locally, and the administrator manually
submits a code to the platform.
Recovery codes are generated and verified by the platform,
not by the authenticator app.
